title: fathah/hermes-desktop
claim: fathah/hermes-desktop — Desktop Companion for Hermes Agent
why_good: A desktop companion for the Hermes agent — a thin wrapper wholly dependent on another project.
value: Little standalone value; it's an accessory, not a product with its own buyers.
risk: Feature, not a company: lives or dies with Hermes and offers no independent moat.
pick_reason: The project offers a clear product that simplifies complex systems for non-technical users, which can be monetized.
